summary: The chip behind the first Macintosh, the Amiga, the Atari ST and the Sega Genesis. It was far more powerful than the 8-bit chips before it.

events.note: Motorola introduces the 68000; chips are on sale from November 1980.

events.label: HMOS ends
events.note: Motorola stops making the original version.

note: Motorola stopped the original chip in 1996; a few later versions were made for years after.
